# Isolde Pembroke

## Overview

- **Age:** 16 or 17 years old by Volume 3  <sub>[v1 c2 P62](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0062), [v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c26 P4](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0004)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c2 P61](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0061)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v1 c38 P0](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0000)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley, St. Brendan's Island  <sub>[v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c15 P15](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0015), [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Izzy  <sub>[v1 c18 P25](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0025)</sub>

## Appearance

Isolde is described as an extremely attractive and lovely girl with rosy cheeks, black hair, and soulful dark eyes. She has a plump, elegant figure, stands an inch shorter than Nell Harcourt, and has a legacy of cheerful looks from her father.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040)_

## Personality

Isolde is cheerful, open-hearted, and pragmatic, though she is easily amused and prone to bursts of laughter. She possesses a comforting nature and deep loyalty, forming an intense, lasting bond of bosom-friendship with Nell. While she is somewhat less inclined to wild daydreams than Nell and prefers practical solutions, she willingly participates in imaginative vows, games, and playhouses. She is also sensitive about proper conduct, feeling shock at swearing or unseemly behavior, and enjoys social events, reading, and learning music.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P26](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0026), [v1 c12 P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027), [v1 c12 P30](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0030), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040), [v1 c13 P13](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0013), [v1 c16 P17](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0017)_

- Cheerful and prone to laughter  <sub>[v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P26](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0026)</sub>

- To learn singing and crochet lace  <sub>[v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040), [v1 c17 P29](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0029)</sub>

## History

Isolde grows up at Pear Hill and becomes acquainted with Nell Harcourt shortly after Nell's arrival at Grey Shutters. Meeting in the Pembroke flower garden, the two girls make a solemn vow of lifelong bosom-friendship over imaginary flowing water. Together, they establish a playhouse called Larkrise in a nearby birch grove, naming surrounding landmarks with imaginative titles, and share books and treats. Isolde attends the Brierley school, sharing a window desk with Nell, where they excel in studies and participate in school yard games and Sunday-school picnics. When Nell is wrongly accused of stealing Thirza's amethyst brooch, Isolde stands by her, and later inadvertently gets tipsy on homemade currant wine served by Nell under the impression it was raspberry cordial. Though Isolde's mother briefly forbids them from playing together, Isolde sneaks out to bid Nell a tearful farewell and exchange a lock of hair, cementing their bond. They reunite after Nell saves Isolde's younger sister Posy Fay from croup, leading Mrs. Pembroke to forgive the misunderstanding. During a winter visit from her strict Aunt Lavinia, Isolde and Nell accidentally jump onto Lavinia's bed in the dark, but Nell's earnest confession saves Isolde's music lessons and wins Lavinia over. Isolde continues her studies at Brierley school, eventually advancing to the fifth class and joining the extra Regent's prep class under Miss Agnes Thorne.

## Background by volume

- Born in Pear Hill, Brierley to Mr. and Mrs. Pembroke, receiving her name from a visiting schoolmaster  <sub>[v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 c2 P64](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0064)</sub>
- Visited her aunt in Delford prior to returning home to Brierley  <sub>[v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c12 P8](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0008)</sub>
- Created an imaginary friend named Lettie Marchant/Melisande in childhood reflections before meeting Nell  <sub>[v1 c8 P43](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0043)</sub>

## Quotes

> Well, I suppose that’s true. I am so happy that you have moved to Grey Shutters. Having a companion to play with will be wonderful.  <sub>[v1 c12 P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027)</sub>

> The act of swearing is remarkably evil, after all.  <sub>[v1 c12 P30](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0030)</sub>

> Nell, you are an unusual girl. I had previously been told that you were unusual. Even so, it seems to me that I am going to be very fond of you.  <sub>[v1 c12 P37](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0037)</sub>

> Most certainly I shall, and no other intimate friend will ever be mine—it is not my desire to possess one. Loving anyone else as deeply as I love you is impossible for me.  <sub>[v1 c17 P5](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0005)</sub>

> You can be certain that my love for you, Nell, is devoted and will last forever.  <sub>[v1 c17 P9](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0009)</sub>
